summary: Baiya International Group filed a 6-K with Q2 2026 financials disclosing the disposal of Juxing, Shenzhen Pengze and related VIEs, classified as discontinued operations, under a Share Purchase Agreement noted around 2026-06-25. No price per share, total consideration, premium or advisor is disclosed in the excerpt. The filing also mentions Starfish Technology FZE, standby equity subscription agreements and digital-asset holdings (BitGo Trust, Native BNB, Tether USD). Watch for completion mechanics, residual liabilities, cash proceeds and the impact on the remaining employment-services business.
